title: Renewal with a narrow exterior door
why: 800 mm is required, but widening a door portal is a structural alteration, which Appendix F does not require.

spec.name: Renewal with a narrow exterior door

exterior_doors.clear_width_mm.required: ≥ 800 mm, unless it needs structural alteration to the door portal
exterior_doors.clear_width_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.3.2(1): 750 < 800. Appendix F, Structures: 'Compliance is not mandatory if the work would require structural alterations to door portals'. A person must judge the work.
